landing.does.title: Built for Food Trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume you have a fixed address, stable wifi and the same opening hours every week. But you go somewhere new every week, at different times, where the mobile signal is poor or absent. HatchGrab was built for that.
landing.does.slotsTitle: Customers choose their own collection time
landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at one time and how long it takes. Once a collection time is full, customers cannot choose that time.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the van — and the card reader you already take payments with.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in your dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp gets answered while you are driving to the pitch or at the grill, using your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp will be answered while you are driving to the pitch or at the grill. Messenger and Instagram will follow.
landing.does.offlineTitle: No signal? You can still keep selling.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the signal drops, online ordering pauses automatically so customers don’t send orders you won’t see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Less queuing, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.steps.title: Set up and start taking orders within about 15 minutes.
landing.steps.lede: Three things to sort out — and two of them only need one photo.
landing.steps.menuBody: Photograph your menu board or paste the text in. Items, prices and extras are all pulled in by themselves. You just check they are correct.
landing.steps.scheduleBody: Have your schedule on your website? We read it from there and keep it updated. If not, photograph it too. You just approve what the system finds.
landing.steps.shareBody: Post it on Facebook, stick the QR code on the van. Orders come into your screen in the order you need to cook them.
landing.testimonial.quote: HatchGrab has made taking orders much easier. Everything is organised, we can track stock and know exactly how many more pizzas are left to sell — and the collection time slots are great for busy villages.
landing.pricing.title: Start free. Upgrade when you need to.
landing.pricing.switchBody: See how much you would pay with HatchGrab for the same number of orders. Takes about one minute.
landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.metaDescription: Clear answers for Food Truck owners about HatchGrab’s prices, setting up, taking orders and payments — what to know before you start.
landing.final.title: Want to see how easy setting up is?
landing.final.lede: Upload a photo or screenshot of your menu and we turn it into a working ordering page for you to play with within 60 seconds. Your items, your prices. No sign-up, no card, nothing to install. Have a look first, then decide.

featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the truck, paid through your own card reader.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen (KDS), and the only way to keep taking orders when the signal drops.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — front counter and kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own login accounts with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the signal drops, online ordering pauses so customers don’t send orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you keep taking orders when there is no internet; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets to a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Manage your service from the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into meal deals and offer extras at checkout to raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with one tap — customers see it greyed out straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock quantity and it counts down as orders come in, then marks itself sold out.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Put a buzzer number on the order when you hand the device to the customer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place, such as food hygiene, insurance and gas safety. We remind you before any document expires, and you can send them to an event organiser or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter the cost of each dish and see how much profit you really made at every event, not just the takings.
featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year, ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone without needing a separate card reader.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, showing order numbers and when the order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment in advance when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event starts.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a closing time for items that must be ordered ahead.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot, spreading orders across your service.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at one time and how long it takes. Once a time slot is full, customers cannot choose that slot.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each order.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t show on the map, with that event’s own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each date links directly to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Put your logo in the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your Food Truck appears on HatchGrab’s public map so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website, or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You just check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we add your dates, places and times automatically, for each week and each event.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: WhatsApp auto-replies for questions about your menu and schedule.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like the WhatsApp auto-replies, for questions via Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Send customers an SMS automatically when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward customers who come back with digital stamp cards — collected and redeemed automatically.

aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for Food Trucks and mobile food businesses: online orders, collection times and fewer repeated questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.title: Built around the way Food Trucks really work
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started from a simple observation: Food Trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory that helps people discover Food Trucks coming to sell in their area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike ordinary restaurants, Food Trucks are always moving, working in different places and serving customers in conditions that keep changing.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: But most of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for Food Trucks and mobile food businesses, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time on repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our goal is simple: make running a Food Truck easier, with tools designed around the way these businesses really work.
